append_to_config: append new key-value attributes to a JSON config file without changing the order of existing attributes
append_single_attribute: append a single tuple attribute to a JSON config file using append_to_config
append_multiple_attributes: append a list of attributes to a JSON config file using append_to_config
review_append_to_config: review the append_to_config function that safely modifies JSON config files preserving key order
test_append_to_config: test the append_to_config function with a sample JSON config file and new attributes
